mapper.select:
/* RevertTodoMapper.selectList */
SELECT A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , A.WRR_INFO , A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD , F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM , A.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS FC_CUNM , A.XPBY_COL_AM AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM , A.CUS_KORL_NM AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM , A.CSNO AS AI_INPT_CSNO , A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD , I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_NM , A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD , J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_NM , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO , CASE WHEN A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD NOT IN ('30', '40') THEN '' ELSE A.FILT_DTCT_NO END AS FILT_DTCT_NO , CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) < 80 AND (A.Q_PRG_STCD IN ('16','24') OR A.STATUS IN ('21','32','42','47')) THEN '오류' WHEN A.DELAY_TIME > (SELECT AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = 371 AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = '01') THEN '지연' ELSE A.WRR_INFO END WARRNING , A.STATUS , A.DELAY_TIME
ORDER BY E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY E.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY FC_CUNM
ORDER BY FC_CUNM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_BUY_AM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_BUY_AM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY H.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY I.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM
ORDER BY J.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM DESC
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY G.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY WARRNING
ORDER BY WARRNING DESC
ORDER BY FILT_DTCT_NO
ORDER BY FILT_DTCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT
